Ava (CS): Heads-up — Citrine goes live tomorrow 10:00am PT. Need a micro-surge priming + lightweight feedback probe. Plan: small prefill, jittered, capture telemetry + 3-question feedback for first 50 sessions. Who can own?

Diego (CS): I can own prefill. Proposed: 20 warm requests/tenant over 5m starting 09:35 PT, enable prefix cache, prefetch ttl=600s. Keep payloads small.

Harper (SRE): SRE can open warm-pool at 09:30 PT and run health checks. Add circuit-breaker: GPU util >=80% for 2m => scale down. I'll watch queue depth and latency.

Ravi (Eng): Add quick probe telemetry: avg p50/p95 latency, top-1 token drop rate, error-rate. We'll emit to cs-metrics endpoint. Example POST:
```bash
curl -X POST https://cs-metrics.internal/api/events -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"tenant":"citrine","metric":"latency_p95","value":123}'
```

Diego (CS): Prefill payload sample (small prompt + light system):
```json
{"prompt": "Summarize in 1 sentence:", "max_tokens": 32, "temperature": 0.0}
```
I'll script jittered timing with sleep random(0,30).

onboard-bot: Reminder: Citrine onboarding checklist item #7 (prefill) scheduled for 2026-03-24T09:35:00-07:00.

Ava (CS): Also capture 3 quick customer questions inline after first response (optional): 1) Helpful? (y/n) 2) Confident in answer? (1-5) 3) Renew intent? (yes/maybe/no) — store as tags. Keep it optional to avoid friction.

Diego (CS): I'll deliver runbook snippet + one-click dashboard link in ~2h.

Harper (SRE): Alert thresholds I'm adding: latency_p95 > 1200ms for >90s, error_rate > 2% over 1m, queue_depth > 60 -> page on-call. Also will enable temporary rate-limit at ingress to keep SLOs.

Ravi (Eng): Minor rollback plan: fallback to smaller quantized model variant (gpt-qa-xq) and enable reduced-batching for 15m. Command to flip routing:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/internal/route -d '{"tenant":"citrine","route":"gpt-qa-xq"}'
```

Ava (CS): Awesome — please post runbook snippet and dashboard link when ready. Heading to final preflight call at 4pm PT. :thumbsup:

Diego (CS): Will do.

Harper (SRE): I'll be on standby in #eng-oncall during the window.

Ava (CS): Thanks everyone — pinning this thread to the onboarding channel. cc @Citrine success lead.
